comment: Whether FedEx shipping rates are offered to customers at checkout.
modal: When **Yes**, FedEx shipping methods are available as options during checkout. Can be set per website.

comment: The carrier name shown to customers for FedEx shipping at checkout.
modal: The label displayed to customers for the FedEx carrier group at checkout. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: The FedEx API key used to authenticate rate and shipping requests.
modal: The API key from your FedEx developer account, used to authenticate requests to the FedEx web services. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

comment: The FedEx API secret key used with the API key to authenticate requests.
modal: The API secret associated with your FedEx API key, used to authenticate requests to the FedEx web services. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether a separate set of credentials is used for the FedEx tracking API.
modal: When **Yes**, a separate set of FedEx tracking API credentials is used for shipment tracking requests, enabling the Tracking API Key and Secret fields. Can be set per website.

comment: The FedEx API key used for shipment tracking requests.
modal: The API key used to authenticate FedEx shipment tracking requests. Applies only when **Enable Tracking API credentials** is set to Yes. Stored encrypted.

comment: The FedEx API secret used for shipment tracking requests.
modal: The API secret used with the tracking API key to authenticate FedEx tracking requests. Applies only when **Enable Tracking API credentials** is Yes. Stored encrypted.

comment: Whether requests use the FedEx sandbox (test) environment instead of production.
modal: When **Yes**, FedEx requests are sent to the sandbox (test) environment rather than production. Can be set per website.

comment: The FedEx production web-services endpoint URL.
modal: The endpoint URL for the FedEx production web services. Applies only when **Sandbox Mode** is set to No. Can be set per website.

comment: The FedEx sandbox (test) web-services endpoint URL.
modal: The endpoint URL for the FedEx sandbox (test) web services. Applies only when **Sandbox Mode** is set to Yes. Can be set per website.

comment: The FedEx pickup method used when requesting rates.
modal: Selects the FedEx pickup type, i.e. how packages are handed to FedEx, used when requesting shipping rates. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether rates are requested per package or for all packages together.
modal: Chooses how package data is sent to FedEx when requesting rates — divided into separate packages or as a single combined request. Can be set per website.

comment: The default FedEx packaging type assumed for rate requests.
modal: Selects the FedEx packaging type assumed when requesting shipping rates. Can be set per website.

comment: The weight unit used for package weights sent to FedEx.
modal: Selects the weight unit used for package weights in FedEx rate requests. Can be set per website.

comment: The maximum weight allowed for a single FedEx package.
modal: The maximum weight of a single package for FedEx shipments; heavier orders are split across packages. Consult FedEx for the maximum supported weight. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the handling fee is a fixed amount or a percentage.
modal: Chooses whether the handling fee added to FedEx rates is calculated as a fixed amount or as a percentage. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the handling fee is applied per order or per package.
modal: Chooses whether the handling fee is applied once per order or to each package. Can be set per website.

comment: The handling fee amount or percentage added to FedEx rates.
modal: The handling fee value added to FedEx shipping rates, interpreted as a fixed amount or percentage per the Calculate Handling Fee setting. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether shipments are rated as residential deliveries.
modal: When **Yes**, FedEx rates are requested for residential delivery, which may change the price. Can be set per website.

comment: Which FedEx shipping methods are offered to customers.
modal: Selects which FedEx shipping services are offered as options at checkout. Can be set per website.

comment: The FedEx method used when an order qualifies for free shipping.
modal: Selects which FedEx shipping method is used when an order qualifies for free shipping. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether free shipping is offered once an order subtotal threshold is met.
modal: Set to **Enable** to offer FedEx free shipping for orders whose subtotal reaches the configured threshold. Can be set per website.

comment: The order subtotal required to qualify for free FedEx shipping.
modal: The minimum order subtotal at which FedEx free shipping becomes available. Applies only when **Enable Free Shipping Threshold** is enabled. Can be set per website.

comment: The message shown to customers when FedEx rates cannot be retrieved.
modal: The error message displayed at checkout when FedEx shipping rates are unavailable. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether FedEx ships to all allowed countries or only selected ones.
modal: Chooses whether FedEx shipping is offered to all allowed countries or only to a specific list set in Ship to Specific Countries. Can be set per website.

comment: The specific countries FedEx shipping is offered to.
modal: Selects the countries to which FedEx shipping is offered when Ship to Applicable Countries is limited to specific countries. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether FedEx request and response data is logged for debugging.
modal: When **Yes**, FedEx API requests and responses are written to the debug log for troubleshooting. Can be set per website.

comment: Whether the FedEx method is still shown when it is not available for an order.
modal: When **Yes**, the FedEx shipping method is displayed at checkout even when it is not applicable, shown with the error message. Can be set per website.

comment: The position of FedEx among shipping methods at checkout.
modal: A numeric value controlling where FedEx appears relative to other carriers in the checkout list; lower values appear first. Can be set per website.
